_comment: P69: webmail texts that promise a permanent delete, which the mail server refuses under the retention policy. tools/prepare_mail.py replaces each 'from' text with 'to' and fails if upstream changed the 'from' text.

account_unread.empty_hint.from: You can empty the {folder} folder to permanently remove all messages.
account_unread.empty_hint.to: Company mail is kept: messages in {folder} are not deleted for good.

email_list.empty_folder.trash_hint.from: You can empty the Trash folder to permanently remove all messages.
email_list.empty_folder.trash_hint.to: Company mail is kept: messages in Trash are not deleted for good.

email_list.empty_folder.junk_hint.from: You can empty the Junk folder to permanently remove all messages.
email_list.empty_folder.junk_hint.to: Company mail is kept: messages in Junk are not deleted for good.

email_list.empty_folder.confirm_message.to: Company mail is kept under the company's retention policy, so nothing in this folder is deleted for good.
